description: Read and write X (Twitter): home and Following timelines, user tweets, single tweets and reply threads, search, trending, profiles and follows, likes, bookmarks and likers/retweeters, plus posting, replying, quoting, liking, reposting, bookmarking, deleting, pinning and full list management on x.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in X session.

tools.name: get_home_timeline
tools.description: Get tweets from the authenticated user's home timeline (For You feed). Returns the most recent tweets. Use cursor for pagination.

tools.name: get_latest_timeline
tools.description: Get tweets from the "Following" tab — chronological timeline of accounts the user follows.

tools.name: get_user_tweets
tools.description: Get tweets posted by a specific user. Requires the user's numeric ID (use get_user_profile to find it from a screen name).

tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific tweet by its ID. Returns the tweet with full engagement metrics, author details, and reply thread context.

tools.name: create_tweet
tools.description: Post a new tweet. Supports plain text and replies. To reply to a tweet, provide the reply_to_tweet_id parameter.

tools.name: quote_tweet
tools.description: Post a quote tweet — a top-level post that embeds and comments on another tweet. Unlike a reply (which lives inside the original thread) or a plain retweet (which adds no commentary), a quote tweet appears on your own profile with your text plus the referenced tweet.

tools.name: delete_tweet
tools.description: Delete a tweet. Only works for tweets authored by the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_tweet_replies
tools.description: Get the reply thread for a tweet. Returns the original tweet and its replies.

tools.name: pin_tweet
tools.description: Pin a tweet to your profile.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a user's profile by their screen name (username). Returns profile details including bio, follower counts, and verification status.

tools.name: get_user_by_id
tools.description: Get a user's profile by their numeric user ID. Use get_user_profile for lookup by screen name.

tools.name: get_following
tools.description: Get accounts that a user follows by their numeric user ID. Returns a paginated list of users.

tools.name: get_user_likes
tools.description: Get tweets liked by a specific user. Requires the user's numeric ID.

tools.name: like_tweet
tools.description: Like (favorite) a tweet.

tools.name: unlike_tweet
tools.description: Remove a like from a tweet.

tools.name: retweet
tools.description: Retweet (repost) a tweet.

tools.name: unretweet
tools.description: Remove a retweet.

tools.name: bookmark_tweet
tools.description: Add a tweet to your bookmarks.

tools.name: remove_bookmark
tools.description: Remove a tweet from your bookmarks.

tools.name: get_likers
tools.description: Get the users who liked a tweet, by tweet ID. Returns a paginated list of users. Useful for engagement-fanout discovery — finding accounts that engaged with a given post.

tools.name: get_retweeters
tools.description: Get the users who retweeted a tweet, by tweet ID. Returns a paginated list of users. Useful for engagement-fanout discovery — finding accounts that amplified a given post.

tools.name: get_bookmarks
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's bookmarked tweets.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Get current trending topics and hashtags.

tools.name: search_tweets
tools.description: Search for tweets matching a query. Supports standard X/Twitter search operators: exact phrases ("hello world"), OR (cats OR dogs), negation (-spam), from/to a user (from:username), mentions (@username), hashtags (#topic), min engagement (min_faves:100, min_retweets:10), filters (filter:links, filter:media, -filter:replies), language (lang:en), date range (since:2024-01-01 until:2024-12-31). Results can be sorted by relevance ("Top") or chronologically ("Latest").

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get details about a list by its ID.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a new list.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Update a list's name, description, or privacy setting.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete a list. Only works for lists you own.

tools.name: get_list_tweets
tools.description: Get tweets from a list's timeline.

tools.name: add_list_member
tools.description: Add a user to a list.

tools.name: remove_list_member
tools.description: Remove a user from a list.
